key_themes: AI semiconductor surge — Intel secures Google TPU foundry order, Marvell added to S&P 500, Cerebras gains on post-IPO analyst initiations
Biotech dealmaking — Nurix Therapeutics soars 43% on $2.3B Roche collaboration for BTK degrader bexobrutideg
Chip sector rebounds from steep Friday selloff, leading broader market recovery

stocks.reason: Shares surged ~43% after announcing a $2.3B global collaboration with Roche ($700M upfront) to co-develop and co-commercialize BTK degrader bexobrutideg across blood cancers, immunology, and neurology

Stock surged ~11% on reports Alphabet/Google placed an order for 3M+ tensor processing units to be manufactured by Intel in 2028, as TSMC faces capacity constraints; Nvidia also reportedly evaluating Intel manufacturing
Shares rose ~8-9% after S&P 500 confirmed Marvell will join the index on June 22, replacing Campbell's; stock is up ~230% YTD aided by Nvidia investment and Jensen Huang endorsement

Shares jumped ~18-20% as Wall Street firms issued a slate of bullish initiations following the AI chipmaker's blockbuster May IPO debut (up 68% on first day); AI infrastructure demand narrative intact
Gained ~2.3% in premarket after announcing partnership with SK Hynix for advanced AI memory for its AI factory buildout; broader chip sector rally following Friday's selloff

Shares popped ~6% after reaching a deal with Amazon to supply optical fiber and connectivity solutions for Amazon's growing U.S. data center infrastructure; stock has more than doubled YTD on AI-driven fiber demand
Stock rose ~2.8% after China May sales data showed 22.6% YoY growth to 47,281 vehicles; exports surged 68% to 38,701 units
Shares gained ~4% after being confirmed as an S&P 500 addition alongside Marvell, effective June 22; replaces Pool Corporation in the index
Shares under pressure after being removed from the S&P 500, replaced by Marvell Technology effective June 22; index-tracking forced selling expected
Jumped ~7.1% as part of broad semiconductor sector rebound; AI memory demand narrative reinforced by Nvidia-SK Hynix partnership and Intel's Google foundry order
Advanced ~8.2% on Monday, benefiting from AI-driven optical infrastructure demand and the broader tech sector rebound
Needham analyst Ami Fadia upgraded from Hold to Buy with a $255 price target, citing improving pipeline prospects and bullish outlook on neurology portfolio
